Validation.heading: Before running
Validation.runtimeNote: This structure is valid, but this runtime refuses to run it:

codes.UNKNOWN_REFERENCE: Something refers to an item that does not exist.
codes.INVALID_PORT: This connection uses a port the node does not have.
codes.DUPLICATE_PORT_EDGE: An output leads to two places.
codes.CALLABLE_IN_CONTROL_FLOW: A callable agent is connected into the flow.
codes.ENTRY_INVALID: The flow must start at an agent outside any Loop.
codes.DEAD_END: This agent has no next step.
codes.DECISION_RULE: This decision's rule does not match its mode.
codes.DECISION_BRANCH_MISSING: A branch of this decision is not connected.
codes.LOOP_BOUNDARY: This connection crosses the Loop boundary outside its ports.
codes.CYCLE_OUTSIDE_LOOP: This connection closes a cycle. Use a Loop to repeat work.
codes.UNREACHABLE: The flow never reaches this node.
codes.NO_OUTPUT: The flow never reaches an Output.
codes.CAPABILITY_TARGET: Calls go from an agent to a callable agent.
codes.CAPABILITY_NOT_ALLOWED: The calling role is not allowed to make this call.
codes.DEPTH_EXCEEDED: This agent is only reachable beyond the delegation depth limit.
codes.BINDING_SOURCE: An input reads from a step that cannot provide it: {message}
codes.REVIEW_CONTRACT: A review decision must read a reviewer's output.
codes.UNKNOWN_MODEL_PROFILE: A role uses a model profile that is not configured.

Reins.heading: Reins
Reins.noTarget: Start a run and choose an execution to steer.
Reins.instructionHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
Reins.deliveredNote: Delivered means the instruction was included in a model request. It does not mean the model followed it.

receipt.queued: Waiting for the next model request
receipt.expired: Not delivered: the execution finished first

Reins.finished: This execution has finished. New instructions can no longer be delivered.
Reins.runScope: Target: Run {runId} · Scope: the whole run
Reins.safeBoundary: Pause closes new admissions, then waits for active requests and tools to settle. Resume keeps pending approvals.
Reins.cancelRunExplain: Cancel all executions and their owned work. Cancellation is confirmed only after cleanup; remote processing and charges may continue.
Reins.connectionUnknown: Receipt not confirmed: {message}. Check the run before retrying.
Reins.draftTargetChanged: This draft belongs to {target}. Choose that execution or explicitly move the draft before sending.
Reins.resumeBeforeRestart: Resume the run before restarting this task.

boundary.safe_boundary: Boundary: after active work is settled

Reins.cancelExecutionExplain: Target: {executionId} and its owned descendants. New work is blocked, then active work is cleaned up. Required work waits for restart or run cancellation.
Reins.restart: Restart task with a new attempt
Reins.restartExplain: Creates a new execution for the same unfinished task after this attempt has terminated. The coordinator checks that its parent still waits for it.

Models.noLive: This server runs simulated agents only.

SettingsPatch.heading: Change settings
SettingsPatch.invalid: Enter a valid value within the supported limits.

boundary.run_limits: Applies immediately to future admissions. Already spent and held usage is retained.
boundary.node_future: Applies when this node creates a future execution. Existing executions and other nodes using the same role stay unchanged.
boundary.loop_limit: Applies at the next round boundary of this loop.
boundary.criteria: Creates a new criteria version. Earlier reviews retain their original criteria and are marked stale.

SettingsPatch.dynamicCount: The number of future executions depends on remaining branches, loop rounds and dynamic calls.
SettingsPatch.spent: {spent, number} confirmed tokens already spent · {held, number} reserved or unconfirmed tokens held
SettingsPatch.stale: The run changed after this preview. Preview again before confirming.
SettingsPatch.notActivated: No execution or iteration activation recorded yet.
SettingsPatch.finished: This run has ended. Its settings history remains available.
SettingsPatch.snapshotsUnchanged: Requests already prepared retain their recorded input snapshots.

guide.heading: Demo guide
guide.intro: Each step is checked off from what the simulated run actually recorded.

steps.delegate: Research hands two parts to Research Helpers. They appear under it in Executions.
steps.ask: The Writer asks the Source Responder a question and gets an answer.
steps.revise: The Reviewer asks for a revision, so the Writer runs a second round.
steps.steer: Optional: steer the round 2 Writer. Your instruction reaches its next request, not the draft it already submitted.
steps.finish: Approve the reviewed draft, then the final output.

guide.pauseAtRound2: Pause the run when the round 2 Writer starts
